labels: A school dress joins its sleeved bodice to its skirt at a visible waist seam, with one continuous front fastening above the seam.; 원피스 교복은 소매 달린 몸판과 치마가 보이는 허리 절개선에서 이어지고 그 위로 앞여밈이 연속된다.
definition: Complete optional school-life visual realization: A school dress joins its sleeved bodice to its skirt at a visible waist seam, with one continuous front fastening above the seam.
aliases: 원피스 교복의 연결
